rationale: This Portuguese-language article is a theoretical-historical analysis of Brazilian central government administrative reform and political culture across four thinker-statesmen (Visconde do Uruguai, Oliveira Vianna, Guerreiro Ramos and Bresser-Pereira). It has no relation to household or community water or sanitation service access (fails C1 and C4) and presents theoretical/intellectual history rather than empirical service-access evidence (fails C3). Excluded under E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings result in exclusion (E01 wrong topic): although the paper discusses macro-level administrative state structure in Brazil (satisfying literal/plain governance subject matter in the abstract), it has no connection to water or sanitation services (failing C1 and C4) and is a theoretical/historical essay on four political thinkers rather than an empirical study (failing C3).

evidence_quotes.quote: Estrutura administrativa do governo brasileiro, cultura política e a busca pela sociedade ideal
A organização e a estrutura do governo central brasileiro mudaram drasticamente entre o período monárquico (1824-1889) e o atual período democrático (1985).
por intermédio da reforma da estrutura político-administrativa do Estado, seria possível mudar a cultura política do povo brasileiro.
